text: Let's start with the basics: can you describe exactly where you feel the pain, and does it radiate to your arm, jaw, or back? Also, have you noticed any sweating, nausea, or dizziness accompanying this?

speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand you've been referred with a confirmed diagnosis of Z-Syndrome, but I must prioritize your safety. Given your description of central chest pain radiating to your left arm and jaw, accompanied by sweating and shortness of breath during exertion, this presentation is highly characteristic of an acute cardiac event.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (likely Unstable Angina or NSTEMI)
